topic: Demographic chart data grouping and display
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating demographic data for Mexico, specifically refining age group categorization. Initially, concerns were raised about the current grouping provided by CityData and the time required to manually re-categorize it into 'Kids (0–11 years) / Teens (12–14 years) / Adults (15–64 years) / Seniors (65+ years)' and create corresponding visualizations.

After reviewing options, the group decided to maintain the existing data structure provided by CityData for now. The visualization format was confirmed as a standard bar chart ('By Age Group') for all clients. To minimize effort, it was agreed that one person would re-group the data slightly, and another person would adjust the front-end display accordingly.

The immediate plan is to wait for CityData to provide updated data before proceeding with any changes.
decisions: The demographic chart will remain in its current bar chart format ('By Age Group').
The team will await updated demographic data from CityData.
action_items: Wait for CityData to provide corrected age grouping data.
